#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(os.environ.get('EIRA_LIVE_ROOT','/media/domenicleonetti/easystore/EIRA/LIVE')).resolve()
STATE=ROOT/'eira_probe'/'universe_library'/'open_book_oai_process.json'
LOG=ROOT/'eira_probe'/'universe_library'/'open_book_oai_harvest.log'
STATE.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
cmd=[sys.executable,'-m','eira2.evidence.open_book_oai_harvester','--all']
with LOG.open('ab',buffering=0) as log:
    p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=str(ROOT),stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True,env={**os.environ,'EIRA_LIVE_ROOT':str(ROOT),'PYTHONPATH':str(ROOT)})
payload={'schema':'eira2_open_book_oai_process_v1','ok':True,'pid':p.pid,'started_unix':time.time(),'command':cmd,'log':str(LOG),'harvest_state':str(ROOT/'eira_probe'/'universe_library'/'open_book_oai_state.json')}
tmp=STATE.with_name(STATE.name+f'.tmp.{os.getpid()}'); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8'); os.replace(tmp,STATE)
print(json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True))
